purpose: Recover and canonicalize existing iPhone Flow shortcuts without inventing replacements.

policy.shared_logic_rule: Reuse existing child Shortcuts/adapters; do not copy common processing between Flows.

runtime_contract.trigger: Existing parent Shortcut Morning calls Morning Flow in the confirmed Morning path; the parent uses the Morning Focus gate.
actions: Find the next Calendar event whose start date is within the next 1 day, sorted by start date ascending, limited to 1 result.
If an event exists, get the current date and calculate minutes until the event start.
If remaining minutes > 90, show the existing '余裕あり' notification.
Else if remaining minutes > 45, show the existing '少し急ぐ' notification.
Else show the existing '急ぐ' notification.
If no event exists, show the existing '今のところ急ぐ予定はありません' notification.
runtime_contract.focus_relation: Focus handling belongs to the existing parent Morning path; Morning Flow itself is not replaced with a new Focus router.
runtime_contract.duplicate_prevention: No second automation or duplicate Flow is introduced. The only confirmed call path remains the existing parent Morning path. Intrinsic run-id/idempotency state is not added to the recovered Morning Flow.
runtime_contract.failure_safe: The recovered Flow is read-only against Calendar and only emits notifications. No external write, purchase, delete, or data migration is added. Missing Calendar result follows the existing no-urgent-plan branch.
